\documentclass{article}
\def\value{outer}
\def\expected{outer}
\newcommand{\register}[1]{%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/before}{%
    \typeout{HOOK-before-\CurrentFilePath/\CurrentFile}%
    \begingroup\def\value{inner}\def\expected{inner}Before }%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/after}{%
    After\endgroup\typeout{HOOK-after-\CurrentFilePath/\CurrentFile}}}
\register{part}
\begin{document}
Start \input{a/part} end.

Again \input{b/part} end.

\AddToHook{file/under_score.tex/before}{\typeout{HOOK-name-\CurrentFile}\CurrentFile: }
\input{under_score}
\ifx\value\expected Restored.\else WRONG.\fi

% N5's registration program, copied from gauntlet-master/master.tex:20-23;
% gmhooked is the definition in gauntlet-master/gmtools.sty:6.
\newcommand{\gmhooked}[1]{\typeout{gmtools: entering #1}}
\newcommand{\gmfilehook}[1]{%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/before}{\gmhooked{#1}}%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/after}{\typeout{left #1}}}
\gmfilehook{math}
\input{sections/math}

\newcommand{\showfile}{Context \CurrentFile}
\input{context}

{\iftrue A\input{closer}B
\end{document}
